alerts.title: Dry Spell Warning
alerts.message: Below-average rainfall expected in the next 2 weeks
alerts.aiAdvice: Consider mulching your crops to retain soil moisture. Prepare irrigation systems. Prioritize watering high-value crops.

alerts.title: Fall Armyworm Outbreak
alerts.message: High infestation reported in neighboring farms
alerts.aiAdvice: Scout your maize fields daily. Apply approved pesticides early morning or late evening. Consider biological control methods.

alerts.title: Heavy Rainfall Expected
alerts.aiAdvice: Ensure proper drainage in your fields. Harvest mature crops if possible. Prepare for potential waterlogging.

alerts.title: Growth Stage Reminder
alerts.message: Your maize crop is entering flowering stage
alerts.aiAdvice: Apply second top-dressing now. Monitor for pests especially fall armyworm. Ensure consistent moisture during this critical period.

alerts.title: Temperature Spike
alerts.aiAdvice: Increase watering frequency. Provide shade for livestock. Monitor for heat stress in animals and plants.
